_readme: What each play level changes. The character picks the level (see "characters" in game_data.json). The levels change only how much the inner voice tells you. hint_parts = which pieces of a hint the voice says, in order: "warning" (only that something is wrong), "problem" (names what is wrong), "part" (names the part that causes it). The words for "problem" and "part" are in inner_voice.json, in dashboard_warnings (a problem line can have one wording per level: easy, medium). Budget, mass, timing windows and supply use are the same for every level. To give a level more or less help, change its hint_parts here and nothing else.
source: Written game-design choice by Kaleb, passed 2026-11-10 (AGENT_SOURCE.md section 2, levels change guidance only). It is NOT a NASA number and NOT a PLACEHOLDER.
